en.title: The option-berth guide
en.lede: What a checkout should run, whether it really is running, and why not. This guide explains the chain of facts behind every oberth command.
en.summary: What option-berth is, the chain of facts, the core loop, and how to read the rest of the guide.

zh.title: option-berth 指南
zh.lede: 一个 checkout 该跑什么、是不是真的在跑、没跑为什么。这本指南讲清 oberth 每条命令背后那条事实链。
zh.summary: option-berth 是什么、事实链、核心循环，以及这本指南怎么读。

en.title: Install oberth
en.lede: One binary, no model account, and no service started by the installer. Confirm the build with version and doctor, then declare your first worktree.
en.summary: The one-line script, go install, Homebrew, release archives, and the platform support.

zh.title: 安装 oberth
zh.lede: 一个二进制，不需要模型账号，安装脚本不会启动任何服务。用 version 和 doctor 确认构建，再去声明第一个 worktree。
zh.summary: 一行脚本、go install、Homebrew、发布包，以及平台边界。

en.title: Your first worktree
en.lede: One checkout, five commands, from an empty directory to a clean stop: declare, start, read, log, stop. The example needs Python 3 and nothing else.
en.summary: The whole loop on Hello Worktree, from an empty checkout to a clean stop.

zh.title: 你的第一个 worktree
zh.lede: 一个 checkout、五条命令，从一个空目录到一个干净的停止：声明、启动、读取、看日志、停止。示例只需要 Python 3。
zh.summary: 在 Hello Worktree 上跑完整闭环：从一个空 checkout 到一个干净的停止。

en.title: One chain of facts
en.lede: Worktree → manifest → service → run → runtime facts. Each station has one writer, and the next station reads only what the previous one published.
en.summary: Why the order matters, how attribution works, and why an unread fact stays unknown.

zh.title: 一条事实链
zh.lede: worktree → 清单 → 服务 → 运行 → 运行事实。每个站点只有一个写入者，下一站只读上一站发布的东西。
zh.summary: 为什么顺序重要、归属怎么确定，以及没读到的事实为什么保持未知。

label.zh: 产品定义 · 对象模型

en.title: Several worktrees at once
en.lede: A run belongs to the checkout that started it. Two worktrees can run the same repository without sharing a port, a database or a stop.
en.summary: Run ownership, automatic ports, ${worktree} data separation, leftover checkouts, and the events stream.

zh.title: 同时跑多个 worktree
zh.lede: 一次运行属于启动它的 checkout。两个 worktree 可以同时跑同一个仓库，不共享端口、数据库或停止动作。
zh.summary: 运行归属、自动端口、${worktree} 的数据隔离、遗留 checkout，以及 events 流。

label.zh: 产品定义 · 对象模型

label.en: Architecture · start, stop and port reservations
label.zh: 架构 · 启动、停止与端口预留

en.title: Declare what should run
en.lede: oberth.yaml is the input to every fact. A person confirms it; an agent may draft it, but only a person adopts it.
en.summary: init, init draft and init adopt, the smallest manifest, and the fields that change behavior.

zh.title: 声明该跑什么
zh.lede: oberth.yaml 是每一条事实的输入。清单由人确认；agent 可以起草，但只有人能采纳。
zh.summary: init、init draft、init adopt，最小清单，以及会改变行为的字段。

label.zh: 清单元数据与严格模式

en.title: up: start services and wait for readiness
en.lede: Services start in depends_on order, and --wait returns only when they actually listen and pass their health checks.
en.summary: Dependency order, prepare, automatic ports, readiness, failure reasons, and restart without losing the address.

zh.title: up：启动服务并等到就绪
zh.lede: 服务按 depends_on 顺序启动；--wait 只在真的开始监听并通过健康检查后才返回。
zh.summary: 依赖顺序、prepare、自动端口、就绪、失败原因，以及不丢地址的重启。

en.title: status: what is running now
en.lede: One read of the worktree, the manifest and the runs, including the honest answer “I cannot see”.
en.summary: Process, listener, health and exit as four separate facts; the table, --brief, --json, and observation failures.

zh.title: status：现在到底跑着什么
zh.lede: 一次读清 worktree、清单和运行记录，也包括那句诚实的“我看不见”。
zh.summary: 进程、监听、健康、退出四种事实；表格、--brief、--json，以及观察失败。

en.title: logs: the service's own output
en.lede: A failure has a log, an exit code and a reason. logs reads them directly, without rebuilding a shell pipeline.
en.summary: One read or a stream, the first error of the current run, and the log of a portless worker.

zh.title: logs：服务自己的输出
zh.lede: 失败会留下日志、退出码和原因。logs 直接读它们，不用重新拼一条 shell 管道。
zh.summary: 一次读取或持续跟随、当前运行的第一条错误，以及无端口 worker 的日志。

en.title: down: stop one project only
en.lede: Stopping is scoped to the worktree that started the services. It never crosses into another checkout.
en.summary: The normal stop, the deleted-checkout entry points, ambiguous groups, and what down never touches.

zh.title: down：只停一个项目
zh.lede: 停止只作用于启动这些服务的 worktree，不会跨到另一个 checkout。
zh.summary: 正常停止、checkout 已删除时的入口、同名组，以及 down 永远不碰的东西。

en.title: Facts as JSON
en.lede: Every command has one machine shape: one JSON value on stdout, diagnostics on stderr, stable error codes.
en.summary: The rules, the stable error codes, a worked status read, and what an absent field does not mean.

zh.title: JSON 里的运行事实
zh.lede: 每条命令都有唯一的机器形状：stdout 恰好一个 JSON 值，诊断写 stderr，错误码稳定。
zh.summary: 规则、稳定错误码、一次 status 的完整读取，以及字段缺失不代表什么。

CLI 契约 · agent 读取的 JSON 字段

en.title: Call oberth from a coding agent
en.lede: The interface is the CLI and --json. Integration means calling it from the tool's own setup, run and cleanup slots. The product installs nothing and configures nothing for you.
en.summary: The three moments to call oberth, the reads an agent opens with, recipes, and the pitfalls that bite in hooks.

zh.title: 从 coding agent 调用 oberth
zh.lede: 接口只有 CLI 和 --json。集成就是在工具自己的 setup、run、cleanup 槽位里调用它。产品不装 hooks、不注册 MCP，也不改任何工具配置。
zh.summary: 三个调用时机、agent 开局的三次读取、接入配方，以及 hook 里最容易踩的坑。

label.en: Integrating orchestration tools and dev servers
label.zh: 接入编排工具与开发服务器

en.title: Leave work for the next session
en.lede: A worktree keeps work records: commands the engine ran, rounds handed to an agent, and how each one ended.
en.summary: The workplace commands, what gets recorded automatically, how a record ends, and why it is not runtime truth.

zh.title: 把工作留给下一个会话
zh.lede: worktree 上保存着工作记录：引擎跑过的命令、交给 agent 的每一轮工作，以及它们各自怎么结束。
zh.summary: workplace 命令、自动记录的内容、记录如何结束，以及为什么它不是运行事实。

en.title: When something looks wrong
en.lede: Most confusion about a local stack comes from a missing fact, not from a broken service. Each symptom here has one first command and one chapter.
en.summary: A symptom-to-command table, the evidence to keep, and what is not a fix.

zh.title: 看起来不对的时候
zh.lede: 本地服务栈的大部分困惑，缺的是一条事实，不是服务坏了。每个症状对应一条命令和一章解释。
zh.summary: 症状到命令的对照表、求助时要留下的证据，以及什么不是修复。
